blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The sole reviewed liability deployment is Ethereum Coin 0x5377680b5986296aa4f9e684e5315a4f24832e56, with 115,617.056531901423851502 tokens at Ethereum block 26344306 (hash 0x83b0878ff157cb03da43c55d4fc122a7f85a61b7e080f5d8a42f26ee4b5c5dd1, 2026-11-04T22:01:23Z); it represents the full on-chain supply and is material. minter() returned Lender 0xf8b349da9244253288f6853835e6582955fd49c9; the Coin and Lender have nonempty direct bytecode and zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin and beacon slots. Exact-match Coin and inherited solmate ERC-20 source contain ordinary transfers and permit, an immutable minter and a caller-only burn; there is no owner, arbitrary-holder burn, blacklist, seizure, holder allowlist or global transfer pause. invUSD is not a wrapper and has no declared parent. Reserve basis: the entire CDP borrower book uses sINV, a protocol-governed staked INV claim. sINV's reviewed governance setters and deposit-only cap do not establish issuer/custodian holder exposure under the DAO/protocol-governance collateral carve-out; underlying market and governance risk remains. The USDS/sUSDS PSM is the only separate reviewed issuer/upgradable-token exposure: even counting its entire recognized 0.000208859022366708 USDS at full exposure, it contributes only 0.0000000616709990756722% of protocol-accounted reserves and does not approach the strict majority test. The CDP debt-weighted qualifying exposure is 0%. Lender and oracle management can alter borrowing economics and pricing, but those primary stablecoin redemption and debt-management rails do not target invUSD holder balances. Verdict No records this materiality-scoped direct/parent/reserve review, not an absence of governance, oracle, collateral or legal risk.

oracleRisk.summary: sINV collateral is marked by an immutable ERC-4626 adapter over an INV/USD SwitchFeed whose operator is the Inverse two-day Timelock. The input feed is replaceable, and its current Curve-based implementation has a governance-controlled fee haircut. These reachable controls prevent a claim of independent pricing; stale and invalid answers take different Lender paths.

branchApplicability.rationale: One sINV borrower market carries the complete paid-plus-free debt book of 116,745.121161218049772300 invUSD at the pin. Its pricing authority, immutable collateral parameters, liquidation rail, absence of committed backstop and bad-debt allocation require branch-scoped review.

branches.summary: The single sINV borrower market uses an ERC-4626 exchange-rate adapter over a governor-controlled INV/USD feed chain. A two-day Timelock can replace the SwitchFeed input; the ten-percent transition check does not prevent a trusted operator from steering the price.

branches.fallbackBehavior: The exchange-rate adapter falls back from previewRedeem to convertToAssets, not to an independent price provider. The paired ETH/USD wrapper switches from Chainlink to RedStone only when the primary answer is stale against its governance-set 3,660-second heartbeat or outside aggregator bounds; it does not separately age-check the fallback, and a primary call or boundary-check revert propagates. Both price paths still use the same governed SwitchFeed, Curve INV/WETH observation and sINV exchange rate. The Lender retains the returned updatedAt: after 86,400 seconds it forces reduce-only and linearly unwinds the price over another 86,400 seconds, flooring the final value at one wei while liquidation remains enabled. A reverting or non-positive feed instead sets reduce-only and disables liquidation, collateral redemption and write-off. New debt also stops whenever protocol-marked collateral value is below total debt.

collateralParameters.note: Pinned collateralFactor 6500 bps; minimum debt 500 invUSD; redemption fee 250 bps (manager may raise to 500 before deadline). Liquidation incentive is zero at 65% LTV and increases linearly to 10% at 70% LTV. Collateral factor and 24-hour staleness threshold are immutable.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any caller may liquidate once debt exceeds 65% of protocol-marked sINV collateral value. Each call burns a positive amount up to min(debt,max(debt/4, 10,000 invUSD)), further bounded by remaining collateral, and pays sINV with a zero-to-ten-percent incentive over 65–70% LTV. There is no configured delay; correct execution still depends on a usable oracle answer and available invUSD.
branches.backstop: The exact Lender dependency set contains no Stability Pool, insurance fund or committed liquidation capital. An external liquidator supplies invUSD and receives the borrower's sINV collateral. Residual debt exceeding 100 times collateral value is written off and redistributed pro rata across surviving paid and free borrowers.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: There is no protocol-global pause or shutdown. Oracle reversion/non-positive answers disable liquidation, collateral redemption and write-off; stale answers instead unwind toward one wei. writeOff() burns no coins: it deletes the affected borrower's debt and reallocates it to survivors. If no borrower remains, the debt is deleted without a recipient and the outstanding coin liability remains.
